text: Exploring the Feasibility of a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) as a New Model for Economic Governance in the Blockchain Era presents the following source proposition: Decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) are a new type of organization that are run using blockchain technology and are designed to operate without the need for traditional management structures. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that A decentralized autonomous organization is merely computer code with no directors, managers or employees, its governance structure built with software, code and smart contracts running on a public decentralized blockchain platform.
